review_description: Darren and the team at STE solar were fantastic to deal with - we had our panels, inverter and battery installed by their team and we found them professional, courteous and happy to help in any way. We would highly recommend them to anyone in the area.

Quoting process gave me confidence;  a qualified experienced electrician explained process, answered technical questions, discussed options. Installation was quick and clean, despite harassment on the roof by plovers. Organised grid connection and called me afterwards to confirm this.

STE quoted after on-site inspection and discussion. Some of the others happy to quote off Google picture of roof.  STE very helpful in understanding the world of solar.Installation organised and proceeded as planned on schedule - no delays. Owner plus his team worked hard and very well together - no load music or swearing. Very professional neat and tidy all through the job.Organised grid connection and other paperwork. Helped install app on phones to monitor system after explaining how to operate system.Would definitely recommend STE. There is always a difference between dealing with the owner who has a real vested interest in getting your business and just another salesperson.

Darren and the team turned up on time and did a great job replacing my old panels with a new system. They went beyond the contract and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a solar installation.

Darren has been patient explaining everything included with the package, pros and cons, basically great customer service. He even committed to the quote while inflation was starting which could've increased the price. Overall great service, a bit pricey package but thats a personal choice.
